notes:
BIM Muhandis MCP — AI ilovalar (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Microsoft Copilot, Grok, Kimi, Qwen, Meta Muse, DeepSeek, Perplexity, Cursor, Windsurf, LM Studio, Cline) uchun Revit, AutoCAD / Civil 3D, Navisworks, Tekla Structures, SketchUp, LIRA-SAPR 2022–2027 va Word / Excel / PowerPoint ulagichi.
O'rnatish: ZIP'ni chiqarib oling → «BIM Muhandis MCP - O'rnatish.exe» → Claude va Revit'ni qayta oching. AI ilovalar o'zi ulanadi. To'liq o'chirish: «BIM Muhandis MCP - O'chirish.exe».
1.8.0: AutoCAD 2026 xatolari tuzatildi — acad_drawing_info (katta chizmalarda NullReference), acad_list_layouts (DictionaryEntry), acad_run_csharp (C# kompilyatori AutoCAD bundle'iga nusxalanmagan edi) · AutoCAD / Civil 3D lentasida Revit'dagi kabi «BIM Muhandis MCP» paneli (logotip, MCP: ON/OFF, Jurnal, Bildirishnoma), sozlamalar oynasi har bir dastur oynasi o'rtasida ochiladi · chap yuqoridagi holat oynasi (Bajarildi · Xato · Qaytarildi) endi AutoCAD, Civil 3D, Navisworks, Tekla, SketchUp va LIRA'da ham · AutoCAD +25 tool: istalgan buyruq va AutoLISP (GeoUzPro, ModPlus, СПДС kabi plaginlar buyruqlari ham), lenta tugmalarini bosish, tizim o'zgaruvchilari, skrinshot, tanlash, har qanday element xossalari, statistika, blok atributlari (CSV), dinamik bloklar, XREF, listlar va viewport, PDF chop etish, DXF/WBLOCK, DWG qo'yish, multileader, qatlamlarni birlashtirish · Civil 3D: profillar va PVI, quvur tarmoqlari, COGO nuqtalar, koridorlar · Revit: boshqa plaginlarni boshqarish — D5 Render, Enscape, ModPlus, BIM Muhandis plagini, pyRevit… tugmalari ekranni egallamasdan bosiladi (rvt_list_addin_buttons, rvt_run_addin_button), Revit buyruqlari (rvt_post_revit_command), skrinshot · istalgan Windows dasturi oynasi bilan ishlash (bm_ui_*): plagin dialoglari, D5, Enscape, LIRA oynalarini o'qish, tugma bosish, matn yozish, rasm · SketchUp 2022–2027 ulagichi (skp_): jism, devor, ekstruziya, komponentlar, materiallar, teglar, sahnalar, kesim, atributlar, statistika (hajm, maydon), eksport/import, skrinshot, erkin Ruby · LIRA-SAPR: karkas hisob sxemasini parametrlardan yaratish (ustun, rigel, plita to'ri), sxemani tahrirlash, natija jadvallari tahlili (eng katta kuch/ko'chish), LIRA holati va faylni LIRA'da ochish · Navisworks va Tekla skrinshot · AI rasmni o'zi ko'radi (MCP image) · AI ilovalar: Windsurf, LM Studio (mahalliy AI), Cline qo'shildi, VS Code + Copilot olib tashlandi; Claude o'rnatilmagan kompyuterda bim-muhandis.mcpb bosilsa — hamma AI ilovalarga ulanadi
1.9.0: 10 ta yetakchi AI bilan ishlaydi — yangi avtomatik ulanadiganlar: Grok Build (xAI), Kimi Code (Moonshot AI), Qwen Code (Alibaba), Meta Muse Code, Copilot CLI va Microsoft Copilot / Windows agentlari (Windows 11 MCP ro'yxati, odr.exe) · «Bulut ko'prigi» (ixtiyoriy, sukut o'chiq): Grok, Meta Muse, ChatGPT (veb) va Perplexity ilovalari uchun maxfiy kalitli HTTPS manzil (Cloudflare Tunnel, bepul) — manzilni nusxalab AI'ning Connectors bo'limiga qo'yish kifoya · Word, Excel, PowerPoint (2016–2024, 365) ulagichi — 30 tool: ochiq hujjatda jonli ishlash, jadvalni bitta tez amal bilan yozish/o'qish, formatlash (ГОСТ jadval chegaralari), diagramma, Word sarlavha/matn/jadval/rasm/shablon to'ldirish, PowerPoint slayd/jadval/rasm, PDF ga saqlash · Revit → Office bitta amal bilan: office_revit_schedule (spetsifikatsiya Excel varag'iga, Word jadvaliga yoki slaydlarga), office_revit_view (vid rasmi slaydga yoki Word'ga), office_import_csv (LIRA jadvali ham) · tool soni cheklangan AI'larda (Grok — 128) avval hozir ochiq dasturlarning tool'lari beriladi · BIM Muhandis plagini chatida DeepSeek modellari (API kalit bilan)
